hooks.text: 可自定义海怪进化路线，每次选择都会同时改变外形与能力
hooks.excerpt: Players can customize the evolution path of the sea monster according to their preferences, and each choice will affect the shape and ability of the sea monster.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 敌人会随环境和进程随机变异，迫使玩家每局重新适应对手并调整战术
hooks.excerpt: Enemies in the game are not static, but randomly mutate as the environment changes and the game progresses, creating unpredictable challenges for the player. Each game is a new experience and players will face different enemies and challenges, which requires players to constantly adapt to the environment and flexibly adjust their tactics.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 关节可装到器官槽位并自由调整位置与朝向，把海怪身体结构直接变成战斗构筑
hooks.excerpt: In addition, the introduction of the joint system allows the player to equip the joint on the organ position, freely adjust the position and orientation of the organ, providing more possibilities for the battle strategy of the sea monster.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
